objective: Let real website evidence strengthen lane and product-package classification for unknown or opaque websites without giving conversation notes or N/LLM write authority.
userFlow: Consultant enters customer/prospect, website, and conversation notes.
If the URL/domain is ambiguous, consultant can paste optional website evidence such as homepage copy, navigation categories, product text, or SC-provided website summary.
Future N/LLM advisory can populate the same evidence shape after reading public website content, but it remains advisory-only.
Run IDB uses website/domain/category/evidence for lane and package identity, then uses notes for ROI, competitive, objections, and live coaching.

doesNotOwn: verified claims not present in evidence

nllmAdvisoryBridge.promptObjective: Read website evidence and return product category, product family, demand moment, confidence, and source basis. Do not approve creation or override governed packet gates.

harnessCoverage: opaque domains with pasted website evidence classify correctly
conversation notes cannot own product identity
food and ingredient language cannot leak into hardgoods or apparel from notes
